unlisted_practices: Privacy-preserving split architecture where a proprietary LLM generates structured categories and transitions without accessing patient data while a local LLM performs evidence acquisition and decisions
Agentic reasoning for handling discordant sign-symptom evidence in ICU organ dysfunction prediction

screen.reason: The paper introduces a benchmark (MIMIC-DOS) and evaluates a newly developed multi-stage agentic reasoning architecture (CARE) that separates local and proprietary LLMs for privacy compliance. Developing and evaluating a new model/agent architecture is not classified as testing a deployer-level safeguard or practice.
